decisions.reason: The perfect binder sits at the core of the firm's announced finishing-equipment portfolio and has been visibly featured on its own page, so management would attribute weak pandemic-era results to temporary causes and keep it.

The fully automatic binder is the high-investment flagship of the binding line, and the firm's public commitment and sunk costs in dealer relationships and training make it likely to persist with the product.

The inline and nearline booklet maker extends the firm's stated postpress direction, and its investment and visible positioning lead management to keep it, expecting demand to recover after the print-market downturn.
